# `scheduler`

Delayed and repeating tasks. Times are in ticks: one tick is one world step (0.2 s on the server). The host calls `guest.run-task` on the main thread when a task is due.

Package `blockheads:api@0.3.1` · Lua table `bh.scheduler` · [WIT source](https://github.com/Blockheads-Club/mod-sdk/blob/dev/wit/blockheads-api/scheduler.wit)

Uses: `types.{api-error}`

## Types

### `task-id` <Badge type="info" text="type" />

```txt
type task-id = u64;
```

Identifies one task of the calling mod.

## Functions

### `run-later` <Badge type="info" text="function" />

```txt
run-later: func(delay: u32) -> result<task-id, api-error>;
```

Runs once after `delay` ticks (0 = at the next tick).

### `run-every` <Badge type="info" text="function" />

```txt
run-every: func(delay: u32, period: u32) -> result<task-id, api-error>;
```

Runs after `delay` ticks and then every `period` ticks (`period` &gt;= 1) until cancelled.

### `run-next-poll` <Badge type="info" text="function" />

```txt
run-next-poll: func() -> result<task-id, api-error>;
```

Runs once in the next network poll (about 16 ms), for quick replies to players.

### `cancel` <Badge type="info" text="function" />

```txt
cancel: func(id: task-id) -> bool;
```

Cancels a task. Returns false if it did not exist or already ran.
